title: Ellipse, foci, axes, eccentricity, and area scaling
terms: ellipse; major axis; minor axis; semiaxis; eccentricity; focal distance; area scaling.

solution.text:
The focal-distance sum is 10. Writing the distances as 2t, t gives t = 10/3, so their prod-
